name: Voice Input
description: Dictate into the composer with browser speech recognition, with remote or offline Whisper transcription as a fallback.

build.command: npx --no-install esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=es2022 --packages=external --outfile=index.mjs && npx --no-install esbuild src/client.ts --bundle --platform=browser --format=esm --target=es2022 --loader:.css=text --external:./vendor/* --outfile=client/entry.mjs

composer.label: Voice input
composer.hint: Click to dictate into the input box (click again to finish)

settings.label: Recognition language
settings.hint: Language shared by browser speech recognition and server transcription

settings.label: Server transcription fallback
settings.hint: Record and send audio to local Whisper or the configured remote endpoint when browser recognition fails

settings.label: Transcription engine
settings.hint: Auto prefers local Whisper and falls back to the remote endpoint

settings.label: Local model
settings.hint: Tiny is faster; small is more accurate but uses more memory

settings.label: Transcription endpoint
settings.hint: OpenAI-compatible base URL, such as https://api.openai.com/v1

settings.label: Transcription API key
settings.hint: Stored privately in the plugin data directory

settings.label: Transcription model
settings.hint: Model sent to the audio transcription endpoint
